details.label: INCORRECT
details.reasoning: The gold target is 11, while the predicted answer explicitly states 12 versions. This contradicts the target count.
details.groundedness_reasoning: Step 1: Citation [4] lists release and end-of-support dates for the versions, and gives the stated support durations for LTS and STS releases. Citation [2] also describes LTS support as three years and STS support as two years. Step 2: The retrieved material includes .NET 10 as well as the earlier versions, and its dates indicate that more than 12 months of support apply to 12 listed versions; .NET Core 3.0 is the short-lived exception. Thus the retrieved evidence does not support the gold target count of 11.
